purpose: Test constructive individual-worker/crew calendar packing of the original monthly collection and completed point-visit plans. Aggregate staff hours do not by themselves establish a worker schedule. This is a supplied availability/greedy-packing diagnostic,not empirical staff roles,daily provisioning or a proof of impossibility.
parents: Exactly the original eight network_duty_visits_20261112 b3_p0 cases and their four threshold-checked open120k-load raw/corrected600/300farmhour food plans. Do not select target-grid winners or use spare-provider additions. Preserve all original maps,people,food,dispatch,source gates and assigned visit providers.
workers_and_calendar: Integer workers=floor(supported institutional people),never ceil fractional people. Report any fractional-support hours removed. Each worker has the original600/12=50 duty-hour monthly cap and the common calendar interval[0,7*365/12] working-hour coordinates,seven working hours per calendar day. Workers are supplied available throughout that interval subject to work cap and assigned absences;this is not observed availability. Charge idle crew synchronization time to elapsed calendar,not duty work. No inter-bin/provider/actor worker reuse.
services: Preserve exact parent services A/B hours as mandatory divisible home duties. Divide their sum equally across integer workers and reserve that interval at the beginning of each worker calendar. This supplied divisible-service assumption is not a roster of actual service jobs or institutional functions. Zero workers with positive obligations or service work exceeding worker caps is an explicit packing failure.
collection_jobs: Reconstruct EVERY existing integer origin_trips job from parent fields and unchanged settlement_monthly_work origin/owner/outward/inward paths. Crew1 duration=7*(outwarddays+inwarddays)+0.25handling hour. Require origin ownership/node order and sum trip costs exactly compatible with original required collection work. Sort jobs decreasing duration,then origin index,then trip serial. Assign each to the earliest-calendar-available worker who can fit its duty cap and month end,worker index tie. Nonpreemptive trips. If a job cannot fit,record it and continue shorter jobs;do not silently drop required grain work or claim unchanged food remains roster-qualified.
visit_jobs: Only at provider/bins with ALL mandatory collection and home service work packed,attempt the original completed visits at their original providers. Duration per worker=parent chosen_cost_hours/crew. Sort decreasing duration,then actor/target index. Among workers whose remaining duty cap fits duration,choose earliest available crew members,index tie;start at maximum crew availability,finish simultaneously within month. Debit duration once per member,record synchronization idle time and task/worker intervals. No partial crews,split tasks,reassignment or extra completed visits. Collection packing failure blocks all planned visits for that provider/bin in this diagnostic.
outputs_and_controls: All four parent collection schedules and eight visit scenarios,all providers/bins/actors. Record worker count/services,collection jobs packed/unpacked,provider-bin mandatory-work success,planned visits packed/blocked_by_collection/unpacked_by_greedy_crew,crew-hours,calendar idle and all worker task intervals. Parent food/people/maps remain untouched. Manufactured fluid-hours-pass-but-whole-job-packing-fails,crew synchronization,service displacement,integer/fractional staff,zero jobs/budget,calendar bounds,deterministic ties,nonmutation and overflow controls before production outputs.
review: Independent scalar schedule reproduction plus explicit worker interval nonoverlap,calendar bounds and duty caps;distinct supported crew members and exact shared visit intervals;origin trip identities/counts/costs and unchanged owners;all planned visit/provider/task partitions and no added visits;mandatory failures explicit;original monthly channel/full-provider ledger ceilings and exact source/map hashes. Byte-exact fresh schedules/results. Split schedules by parent/month to bound memory and file sizes. Greedy failure is not a proof no schedule exists.
publication_and_continue: Publish all eight visit outcomes,four parent collection summaries,calendar/shortfall charts and downloads in normal research atlas;post every figure,browser/mobile/Windows checks,whole release1-4/S1-S5 review,push and continue. No original map/default replacement or actual observed roster/daily food qualification.
